Container.Name: netlens
Container.Overview: NetLens — a dashboard for UniFi networks. Self-hosted. Per-device and per-app traffic with time charts and sessions; Wi-Fi signal, roaming and presence per device; access point, switch and gateway health; security events; local-network traffic; WAN status. It samples your UniFi console around the clock, so history is kept beyond UniFi's own short retention (24 hours of 5-minute data, 7 days hourly). Needs a UniFi OS console (UDM, UCG, UDR, Cloud Key Gen2+) and a local API key. After installing, open the web UI: a short setup asks for your console address, the API key and a login password. Not affiliated with Ubiquiti.
Container.Requires: A UniFi OS console reachable from this server, and a local API key (UniFi Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations > Create API Key).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the dashboard in your browser.

Config.Description: Cache, settings and logs. Keep it on appdata so updates never lose history.
